title: Psychedelic Mushroom Oracle
description: A surreal psychedelic scene features a large teal and magenta mushroom with a woman's face emerging from its cap, her green curly hair flowing into the night. She holds a glowing lightbulb with an eye inside while a reptilian creature covered in multiple eyes sits to the right. Below are glowing stained-glass buildings, above floats an ornate dripping heart symbol with a crescent moon backdrop filled with stars, lightning, and fairies.
